description: Policy for managing marketplace entries for already-ported plugins.
scope: Manage existing/ported plugin marketplace entries only. Never convert plugin formats.

operations.validate: Check marketplace.json entries point to real plugin directories with valid manifests.
operations.remove-stale: Remove entries whose referenced plugin path no longer exists.
operations.refresh: Re-read plugin manifest and update marketplace entry fields.
operations.verify-unique: Ensure each plugin appears exactly once in marketplace.json.
operations.reinstall: Remove cached copy and re-clone/re-copy from source.

safety: Always back up marketplace.json before modification.
Never add new plugins to marketplace — only manage existing entries.
Report but do not auto-fix entries with mismatched versions.
